meta.title: Fresh Green Skin
meta.description: Fresh white-green theme with custom wallpapers (image/video), system-following or wallpaper-derived palettes, translucent panes, brand colours, quick chips, fonts and named themes
meta.detail: Settings → General → Wallpaper: bundled 4K photo, your own image or a looping video, transparency (optionally adaptive); palettes that follow the host theme, the wallpaper, or your own per-area colours picked from the photo; translucent sidebar and bubbles, brand colours, quick-launch chips and a font picker; save the whole look as a named theme and switch with Ctrl+Alt+digit.
